newsitem.title: UK: Palladium fixes at lowest in three years.
newsitem.headline: Palladium fixes at lowest in three years.

text.p: Palladium fixed at the lowest since September 20, 1993 amid continued downward pressure on the market.
It fixed at $121.00 per ounce, down 50 cents from the morning fix.
"Palladium has gone through support at $122, and technically it looks really poor," a dealer said.

Last Wednesday the market slid to the lowest levels since December 1993 as investment funds and other speculators liquidated long positions. If prices dipped below $120.00, the next important support level was at $112, dealers said.
Steady selling by Russia, the largest producer, during the slow summer season together with sluggish demand from the Japanese electonics sector has battered the market.
The greyish-white metal -- used in the auto industry, electronics and dentistry -- has been in a downward trend since peaking at $178.50 in April 1995.
